message: The other day, I was rummaging through our go-bags and found a stash of snacks I had tucked away a while back. I chuckled to myself, remembering how my daughter rolled her eyes when I insisted we prepare for unexpected adventures. Well, when the storm warnings came through, she was the first to grab a bag and check the supplies. 😄 It’s funny how those little moments can turn into a gentle reminder that being ready can sometimes feel smugly satisfying. Have you had any ‘I told you so’ moments lately?
